# GAR reports on Christopher Bogart's remarks at GAR Live Dubai


- International arbitration


November 14, 2024


-
-

-


Burford CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) discussed how "\[r\]ising counsel fees and a lack of predictability in arbitrators' approach to costs are making it economically unviable to finance certain cases" at GAR Live Dubai. GAR reports on Bogart's remarks.
